purpose: Permit reproducible cleanup of project-owned baseline model weights after accepted reproduction while retaining all evidence needed to rerun and compare the experiment.
cleanup_preconditions: the reproduction run has TERMINAL_ACCEPTED status
the run artifact inventory and result rows pass validation
the model path is inside an ephemeral_model_scope path for that exact run
a read-only ownership and reference audit finds no other run or process using the path
the retained manifest is sufficient to download the same immutable revision again
the deletion target is an explicit resolved path without globs or environment expansion
failure_rule: Rejected, incomplete, or unaudited runs do not authorize model deletion unless a separate abandoned-run cleanup record preserves the same provenance and proves the path is project-owned and unshared.
shared_model_rule: Existing Qwen, embedding, reranker, and CLIP assets on the server are treated as shared or pre-existing until provenance proves otherwise and therefore are not cleanup targets.
